children.name: Text
children.characters: Desktop: the page is the Stage (brightest sheet, big rounded left corners, flush to the right and bottom edge). Feed on the left, Next meetings / Birthdays / Events on the right.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Phone: one column. Menu (left) and Today (right: next meetings, birthdays, events) are two hidden sidebars. The Stage slides right or left to uncover them.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Mobile dock (idea): a floating pill with Menu, Feed, a raised Compose button, Meetings (green dot when one is on) and Today. When a meeting is on now, an 'On now · Join' chip rides above the dock. Swipe from either edge does the same as the dock buttons.

children.name: Text
children.characters: Components on this page: Your profile button, Find someone input, Composer (textarea, Also share to chips, Photo, visibility select, Post note), Feed items (highlight with source and your note, note with link card), Note actions, Next meetings, Birthdays, Events.
